DEMO CAPTURE · sample metadata, lyrics and audio levels · no live playback
We leave the noise behind us
A quiet line across the sky
And every window holds a light
We take the long way home tonight
No hurry at the turning signs
Just glass and shadow moving slowly
The morning waits beyond the river
The night has room for one more song
